findings.body: Raise: Functional. `native.offer` calls `machine.join` before printing its JSON handout. When all agent places are occupied, `machine.join` prints a waiting message to stdout, so the command eventually returns that message followed by JSON. A coordinator expecting the documented JSON instruction cannot parse it. The native read test parses the entire stdout but never fills the agent line.
findings.title: Native read handout stops being valid JSON when the agent line is full
